description: A small agency that sets up social media engagement automation for small businesses: it finds conversations where the business could genuinely help, and drafts useful replies for a human to approve before posting.
target_audience: Small business owners, founders and solo marketers who are trying to get customers from social media and are short on time.
comment_tone: Plain, helpful and specific. Short sentences. Answer the question first, mention what we do only if it is directly relevant.
avoid: do not pitch in the first reply
no medical, legal or financial advice
topics: social media marketing for small business
